_comment: Cross-dataset identity fixes for the site-level merge. slugAliases: variant -> canonical (slugs computed with the unified slugifier: diacritics stripped, apostrophes dropped). preferredNames: canonical slug -> display name override.
_notes: cindy-yushi-tsai: IJSO 2007 sources (OBC/wiki/OLC majority) spell Yushi; the IOAA 2008 dataset has Yuchi (single Objetivo-style variant). Provisional canonical = Yushi; revisit if a primary document surfaces.
imo d-emidio divergence is handled automatically: the merge re-slugs everyone from the display name with the unified rule, so per-folder id spelling differences cannot split people.
thiago-bergamaschi: IJSO 2014 'Thiago R. Bergamaschi' = IPhO 2016 'Thiago Bergamaschi' (user-confirmed 2026-08-22). NOT his brother Thomas Ross-White Bergamaschi (distinct.json).
pedro-seber-e-silva: IChO 2016 'Pedro Silva' = 'Pedro Seber e Silva' per ABQ-SP records the fuller form — links his IChO silver to IOAA 2016 bronze.
luis-fernando-machado-poletti-valle: OLC records the fuller 'Machado' form; OIbF 2013 + IOAA 2013 same person.
gabriel-tavares-bujokas: IOI 2006 short form; ultra-rare surname, adjacent years to IMO 2004/05.
nicholas-de-souza-costa-lima: IChO 2013 ABQ short form vs IJSO 2011 OBC full form; junior-to-senior progression.

italo-rennan-lima-silva: IPhO 2016 'Italo Silva' (ipho-unofficial abbreviation) = IJSO 2014 silver medalist from Fortaleza-CE; classic junior-to-senior progression, rare given name (user-confirmed as most likely, 2026-08-22).

eleni-claire-shor: competed IPhO 2019 under a former name (user-confirmed 2026-08-22); alias future-proofs against splits if older records surface. hideVariants keeps the former name out of the public UI — display is always the current name.

OII merge batch 2026-08-22: ten IOI-DB short forms folded into OII/OBI full forms — every pair pre-documented in the ioi collection's name-variants cross-check (plus Cesario 2002 IOI = 2004 CIIC, rare name + era). Frederico: IOI 'Souza' vs OII/OBI 'Sousa' — Sousa canonical.

carolina-moura: IOI-DB short form (2020-22) = Carolina Moura Valle Costa (OII/EGOI; pre-documented in ioi variants table). Missed by the detector's last-token blocking — bug fixed same day (block on all tokens).

leonardo-henrique-martins-florentino: OIbF 2015 dataset lacked the surname Florentino — NOIC's contemporary roster spells 'LEONARDO H. M. FLORENTINO' (flag opened in the oibf source pass, closed by the widened detector 2026-08-22). IJSO 2013 silver = same person.

2026-08-25: imported all 16 slug aliases from small-world's scripts/lib/aliases.ts as defensive no-ops — their merges are already baked into our canonical physics raw files, but the variant spellings survive in the provenance scrape files (ipho-unofficial.json, supplementary.json, eupho-pdfs.json); these aliases guard any future rebuild-from-scrape or source reusing the short/typo forms.
ian-barreto-tavares-matos-de-vasconcelos: IChO official DB abbreviates 'M' = Matos (IMChO 2025 official xlsx has the full form). Same student, IChO 2025 bronze + IMChO 2025 bronze.

OIAQ merge batch 2026-08-26: eleven IChO short/variant forms folded into OIAQ full forms (same-year chemistry pairs: Arthur Braga Reis, Celso Renan, Davi Aragão, Caminha, Lígia, Pedro Madeira Nóbrega, Maurocélio+Filho, Teotônio Sousa/Souza, Yuri Morales/Moraes, Castelo Branco, Mathews/Matheus, Ivna F.=Ferreira). Souza/Moraes/Matheus display forms chosen where sources conflict.
